limitations: Deterministic three-color, contact threshold exactly two, complete nonempty bipartite shores only. A fully enumerated finite symbolic quotient is used as a lemma; not an independent formal verification. Historical priority may be affected by unindexed specialized results.
title: A five-step cutoff and coexistence threshold for two-contact excitation on complete bipartite graphs
